'''July 2001 EPP Overdrive tournament (Bridgewater Crew)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 18 July 2001. [[Michael Pistone]] won it. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2669">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-madskills-epp-overdrive-ls-owns-youd2669/ madskills-epp-overdrive-ls-owns-you], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 19 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-madskills-epp-overdrive-ls-owns-youd2669/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 July 2001
* '''Format:''' [[EPP Overdrive]]
* '''Players:''' 6
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Pistone]]
